description: Create a zero-middleman-fee UnFee payment short link (/to/<wallet>/<amount>/<currency>), hosted checkout URL, dynamic OpenGraph social preview card, scannable SVG QR code, and 1-line HTML embed snippet for Base (USDC, ETH, cbBTC, EURC) or XRPL (XRP, RLUSD).
